import numpy as np
RES=np.array([83,88,222,254,444,495,506,601])
for l in range(0,9):
    P=f'bert.encoder.layer.{l}.'
    q=W(P+'attention.self.query.weight'); k=W(P+'attention.self.key.weight'); v=W(P+'attention.self.value.weight')
    o=W(P+'attention.output.dense.weight'); w1=W(P+'intermediate.dense.weight'); w2=W(P+'output.dense.weight')
    qb=W(P+'attention.self.query.bias')
    zeroq=[h for h in range(12) if np.abs(q[64*h:64*h+64]).max()==0]
    writers=[h for h in range(12) if np.abs(o[RES][:,64*h:64*h+64]).max()>0]
    print(l,'Qcols',np.abs(q[:,RES]).max().round(3),'Kcols',np.abs(k[:,RES]).max().round(3),'Vcols',np.abs(v[:,RES]).max().round(3),'W1cols',np.abs(w1[:,RES]).max().round(3),
          'Orows',np.abs(o[RES]).max().round(3),'W2rows',np.abs(w2[RES]).max().round(3),'b2res',np.abs(W(P+'output.dense.bias')[RES]).max().round(3),'boRes',np.abs(W(P+'attention.output.dense.bias')[RES]).max().round(3),
          'zeroQ heads',zeroq,'RES writers',writers)
